topic: Holomorphic Dynamics: The Art of Iterated Infinity
target_audience: Undergraduate STEM students and advanced high schoolers with an interest in visual mathematics.

sections.title: The Playground: The Complex Plane
lecture_lines: Welcome to the playground of holomorphic dynamics.
We begin with the infinite complex plane.
Every point is defined by real and imaginary parts.
This plane is a dynamic map for movement.
Watch as points shift across this mathematical space.
animations: Display "Holomorphic Dynamics" title in light blue (#ADD8E6) centered, then fade out.
Fade in a white (#FFFFFF) coordinate grid.
Label the horizontal axis 'Real' (#ADD8E6) and vertical axis 'Imaginary' (#FFB6C1).
Place a yellow point (#FFFF00) labeled 'Zoe' at coordinates (1, 1).
Animate 'Zoe' gliding smoothly from (1, 1) to (2, -1).

sections.title: The Engine: Iteration and Functions
lecture_lines: Iteration is the heartbeat of this system.
We apply a mathematical rule repeatedly.
The formula z next equals f of z.
Each output becomes the next step's input.
An orbit tracks a point's journey through time.
animations: Display the formula 'f(z) = z^2 + c' centered in white (#FFFFFF).
Animate a flow diagram: Input z -> Function Box -> Output z_next -> Input z.
Show a point at 0 on a number line, then jumping to 1, 2, and 5.
Highlight the numbers 1, 2, 5 with a pulsing scale-up effect.
Animate the point accelerating and disappearing off the right edge.

sections.title: Stability vs. Chaos: The Fatou Set
lecture_lines: Some regions exhibit predictable and stable behavior.
This stable territory is called the Fatou Set.
Nearby points move together like a calm pond.
animations: Show two light cyan (#E0FFFF) points placed very close together.
Move both points along identical smooth, circular paths simultaneously.
Color the background region behind them light blue (#00008B) labeled 'Fatou Set'.

sections.title: The Boundary of Wonder: The Julia Set
lecture_lines: The Julia Set marks the boundary of chaos.
Here, tiny changes lead to drastically different futures.
This complex edge is jagged and infinitely detailed.
animations: Draw a white (#FFFFFF) jagged line representing a mountain ridge.
Place a green point (#00FF00) and a red point (#FF0000) on the ridge; they fall into separate valleys.
Transform the ridge into a glowing fractal Julia set boundary (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: The Master Catalog: The Mandelbrot Set
lecture_lines: The Mandelbrot Set catalogs all possible Julia Sets.
It depends on the starting parameter value c.
Inside, the Julia Set forms one connected piece.
Outside, it shatters into a dust of points.
It is a dictionary of infinite dynamical worlds.

Highlight a point 'c' inside the silhouette with a yellow circle (#FFFF00).
Show a small connected 'snowflake' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/snowflake.svg] fractal appearing next to the point.
Highlight a point 'c' outside the silhouette in the black void.

sections.title: Infinite Zoom: The Self-Similarity Property
lecture_lines: Holomorphic functions create perfectly smooth, infinite fractals.
Zooming in reveals the same level of complexity.
Patterns repeat forever in a dance of self-similarity.
